summary: Use the generated role by including it in a play, then calling myos_interfaces and myos_facts by short name.
questions: How do I use a resource module packaged in a role?

answer_card.title: Use the generated role
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: myos101
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - my_role

- hosts: myos101
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - myos_interfaces:
      register: result
    - myos_facts:
    - debug: { var: ansible_network_resources }
```
